title: Test-run docs and TestRunDisk::read comment still say a failed results read is never cached
outcome: docs/features/test-runs.md (the Refresh section, about lines 590-600) and the TestRunDisk::read doc comment (src/test_runs_disk.rs, about lines 556-568) say that results read whole but unparseable, with no earlier good read (TestRunJson::Malformed), are kept until the request or results stamp changes, while I/O failures, Missing and request failures are still read again on every rescan.
acceptance: Both texts describe the Malformed reuse and the unchanged re-read of I/O failures, Missing results and request failures, with no contradiction left between them and the code.
